The country famous for the Great Barrier Reef is Australia.

The provided text exhibits significant bias through the use of hyperbolic and subjective language. Phrases such as "no other author has ever come close to the genius" and "single-handedly defined" are absolute statements that leave no room for nuance or alternative viewpoints. By claiming that modern writers "merely dance around the edges," the text dismisses the contributions of contemporary authors as insignificant, creating a false dichotomy between Asimov's "literary greatness" and everyone else's work. This argumentation relies on emotional appeal and exaggeration rather than objective analysis, presenting a highly personal opinion as an undisputed fact.
